cues.zh: 这个视频会有点不一样。
cues.en: This video will be a little different.

cues.zh: 我不确定把它称为观点类内容是否完全准确，
cues.en: I’m not sure if it’s exactly correct to call this an opinion piece,

cues.zh: 但这主要是一个关于我个人能源管理技巧的故事，
cues.en: but this is largely a story about my personal energy management techniques,

cues.zh: 我从中学到的经验教训，
cues.en: the lessons I’ve learned from them,

cues.zh: 以及我们如何在不久的将来应用它们。
cues.en: and how we might apply them in the near future.

cues.zh: 促使我做这个视频的，还有一些新闻标题把这种技术描绘得很糟糕，
cues.en: I’ve also been motivated to make this video by headlines that paint the technique in a pretty bad light,

cues.zh: 而事实上那些恐怖故事完全源于糟糕的管理决策，
cues.en: when in fact the horror stories have everything to do with bad management decisions,

cues.zh: 和这个理念本身毫无关系。
cues.en: and nothing to do with the idea itself.

cues.zh: 这个理念就是负荷侧能源管理。
cues.en: That idea is load-side energy management.

cues.zh: 它最近招来了一些负面报道，因为如今的使用方式通常是被动应对，很少是主动预防。
cues.en: It’s gotten some nasty press lately because the way it’s used today is usually reactive and rarely proactive.

cues.zh: 随着极端天气事件频率上升，
cues.en: As the frequency of extreme weather events goes up,

cues.zh: 我们发现越来越多的情形是电网的能源需求超出了其供应能力。
cues.en: we’re finding more and more instances of energy demand on the grid outstripping its ability to supply it.

cues.zh: 遇到这些情况，电网运营商往往别无选择，只能甩负荷，
cues.en: In those cases, grid operators often have no choice but to shed load,

cues.zh: 或者切断某些地区的供电，以免电网过载，
cues.en: or shut off the power to certain areas to prevent the grid from being overloaded

cues.zh: 在特别极端的情况下，甚至会导致整个电网崩溃。
cues.en: or in particularly extreme cases, collapsing altogether.

cues.zh: 2021年得克萨斯州的冬季风暴中，这种情况就险些发生。
cues.en: That nearly happened in Texas in the winter storm of 2021.

cues.zh: 但通过轮流停电、断开用户来甩负荷
cues.en: But shedding load by disconnecting customers in rolling blackouts

cues.zh: 是一种相当粗暴的手段。
cues.en: is a rather blunt instrument.

cues.zh: 这很糟糕。
cues.en: It sucks.

cues.zh: 很长一段时间以来，电力公司一直在尝试更精确、干扰更小的甩负荷技术，
cues.en: For a long while electric utilities have been flirting with more precise and less disruptive load-shedding techniques

cues.zh: 称为需求响应。
cues.en: called demand response.

cues.zh: 甚至在联网智能恒温器普及之前，
cues.en: Even before internet-connected smart thermostats were widespread,

cues.zh: 包括我所在公司在内的某些电力公司就提供折扣，只要你允许他们在用电高峰时段远程关掉你的空调
cues.en: some utilities including mine offered discounts if you allowed them to remotely disable your air conditioning

cues.zh: 或者用锁定装置关掉你的烘干机。
cues.en: or perhaps clothes dryer using a lockout device during peak consumption periods.

cues.zh: 当然，这偶尔会带来一些轻微的不适和烦恼，
cues.en: That could of course lead to some mild discomfort and annoyance occasionally,

cues.zh: 但至少你还有电可用。
cues.en: but at least you still had power.

cues.zh: 你的邻居也是如此。
cues.en: And so did your neighbors.

cues.zh: 你看，供暖和制冷是家庭或一般建筑中最大的能源消耗项。
cues.en: See, heating and cooling is by far the biggest energy consumer of a home or building in general.

cues.zh: 在炎热的日子里，当每个人的空调同时运转时，用电需求会突然激增，
cues.en: And on hot days demand can suddenly explode when everyone’s air conditioners start running at the same time,

cues.zh: 因此，能够通过临时关掉几千台空调来缓解电网的总需求，
cues.en: so being able to ease the total demand on the grid

cues.zh: 对电力公司来说是非常有用的手段。
cues.en: by temporarily shutting off a few thousand air conditioners is a very useful tool for utilities.

cues.zh: 我知道你们有些人在想什么——
cues.en: Now I know what some of you are thinking -

cues.zh: “这听起来太糟糕了，我绝对、绝对不会想要这样！”
cues.en: "that sounds terrible and I would never, ever want that!"

cues.zh: 但如今，我们拥有的灵活性比以往任何时候都多。
cues.en: But these days, we have more flexibility than we ever have.

cues.zh: 如果电力公司能在供电出现问题之前就打开你的空调呢？
cues.en: What if the utility could turn your air conditioner ON before there was a supply problem?

cues.zh: 既然智能恒温器已经如此普及，
cues.en: Now that smart thermostats are so common,

cues.zh: 电力公司就有大量客户安装了
cues.en: utilities have plenty of customers who have installed

cues.zh: 远比过去那种空调断电装置更精密的设备。
cues.en: much more sophisticated equipment than the air conditioner lock-outs of the past.

cues.zh: 只要方法得当，我们就能挖掘出一个巨大的储能来源，
cues.en: And if done correctly, we can tap into a huge source of energy storage

cues.zh: 而你可能从未意识到它的存在。
cues.en: that you may have never realized we had.

cues.zh: 我们经常谈到电网需要储能。
cues.en: We often talk about the need for energy storage on the grid.

cues.zh: 无论是为了提升风能、太阳能等可再生能源的可行性，
cues.en: Whether that’s to increase the viability of renewable sources of energy like wind and solar power

cues.zh: 还是为了帮助应对间歇性的高峰负荷，
cues.en: or to help meet intermittent peak loads,

cues.zh: 手头有一份能量储备都是件大好事。
cues.en: having a reserve of energy on hand is a very good thing.

cues.zh: 事实上，临时储能这个想法一点也不新鲜。
cues.en: In fact the idea of temporary energy storage isn’t new at all.

cues.zh: 当然，如今时髦的话题是大型电池组，
cues.en: Of course the trendy thing now is to talk about huge banks of batteries

cues.zh: 在能量充足时充电，在之后需要时放电。
cues.en: that are charged up when there’s lots of energy available, and discharged when that energy is needed later.

cues.zh: 随着时间推移，电动汽车很可能成为这一策略的重要组成部分。
cues.en: Electric vehicles are likely to become a big piece of this strategy as time goes on.

cues.zh: 但其实我们做这件事已经很久了，只是方式比较粗糙。
cues.en: But we’ve actually been doing this for a very long time, just more crudely.

cues.zh: 大多数情况下我们这么做，是因为电网负荷是变化的
cues.en: For the most part we’re doing this because the load on the grid is variable

cues.zh: 而且往往在下午达到峰值。
cues.en: and tends to peak in the afternoon.

cues.zh: 你可能听过这个说法，但发电最棘手的地方在于
cues.en: You may have heard this before but the trickiest thing about electrical generation

cues.zh: 供需必须时刻保持平衡。
cues.en: is that supply and demand have to be equal all the time.

cues.zh: 需求一上升，供应就必须增加来满足它。
cues.en: Whenever demand goes up supply must increase to meet it.

cues.zh: 一旦做不到，系统就会开始出问题。
cues.en: And when that’s not possible things start breaking.

cues.zh: 从一开始，这就是电网面临的一大挑战，
cues.en: That’s been a challenge for the grid since the beginning,

cues.zh: 也正是抽水蓄能电站存在的原因，而且已经存在了几十年。
cues.en: and is the reason pumped hydroelectric storage facilities exist and have for many decades.

cues.zh: 这类设施由两座位于不同海拔的水库组成。
cues.en: These facilities consist of two water reservoirs at different elevations.

cues.zh: 有时它们是天然的，有时则是人工设计的。
cues.en: Sometimes they’re natural and other times they’re engineered.

cues.zh: 当供应大于需求时，
cues.en: When supply is greater than demand,

cues.zh: 我们就用多余的电力把水抽到更高的水库中。
cues.en: we use that spare supply to pump water to the higher reservoir.

cues.zh: 这样就储存了重力势能。
cues.en: That makes a store of gravitational potential energy.

cues.zh: 然后，当需求开始超过供应时，
cues.en: Then, when demand starts to outpace supply,

cues.zh: 我们就让水落下来，并在下落过程中捕获它的动能
cues.en: we just let the water fall back down and capture its kinetic energy as it does so

cues.zh: 通过涡轮机发电，从而帮助满足新的需求。
cues.en: in turbines which generate electricity, thereby helping to meet the new demand.

cues.zh: 这就像给电池充电和放电一样，
cues.en: It’s just like charging and discharging a battery,

cues.zh: 只不过这块电池是由水和重力构成的。
cues.en: except the battery is made of water and gravity.

cues.zh: 这种技术最大的问题是它非常依赖地理条件，
cues.en: The biggest problem with this technique is that it is very geography dependent

cues.zh: 而且往往会破坏生态，
cues.en: and tends to be ecologically destructive

cues.zh: 除非你运气特别好，在山坡上正好有一对湖泊之类的。
cues.en: unless you get a really lucky pair of lakes on a mountainside or something.

cues.zh: 对于抽水蓄能和其他储能方式，
cues.en: In the case of pumped hydro and other storage,

cues.zh: 我们完全是在供应侧应对需求波动。
cues.en: we’re taking care of demand fluctuations entirely on the supply side.

cues.zh: 这基本上一直以来的做法，
cues.en: That’s pretty much how it’s always been done,

cues.zh: 而这似乎也是许多人仍然在沿用的框架。
cues.en: and that seems to be the framework that many people are still thinking in.

cues.zh: 有很多巧妙的想法在流传，让储能更可行、更可扩展，
cues.en: There are lots of clever ideas floating around to make energy storage more viable and scalable,

cues.zh: 从堆叠混凝土块的塔，
cues.en: from towers stacking concrete blocks,

cues.zh: 到熔盐电池和液流电池，
cues.en: to molten-salt and flow batteries,

cues.zh: 再到巨大的旋转飞轮。
cues.en: to massive spinning flywheels.

cues.zh: 所有这些都力求成为储存多余能量的地方，当我们有更多或更清洁的发电可用时，
cues.en: All of these strive to be a place to put excess energy when we have more or perhaps cleaner generation available

cues.zh: 以便日后没有时可以使用。
cues.en: so that it can be used later when we don’t.

cues.zh: 当然，目前电网上的储能并没有我们希望的那样多，
cues.en: Now of course we don’t have as much storage on the grid as we’d perhaps like,

cues.zh: 所以许多公用事业公司提供（在某些情况下要求使用）分级费率结构。
cues.en: so many utilities offer (or in some cases require the use of) tiered rate-structures.

cues.zh: 这也不是什么新点子。
cues.en: Again, that’s not a new idea.

cues.zh: 问问任何英国人就知道。
cues.en: Just ask any British person.

cues.zh: 但就我而言，我是自愿选择按小时计费的
cues.en: But in my particular case, I’ve volunteered for an hourly rate

cues.zh: 费率是根据我的电力公司实时支付的能源成本来定的。
cues.en: that’s set based on the cost my utility pays for energy in real-time.

cues.zh: 他们提供这种方案，是为了鼓励大家把用电需求从高压力时段转移开，那些时段对他们来说成本更高，
cues.en: They offer this to encourage shifting demand away from high-stress periods which cost them more,

cues.zh: 可以说他们几乎把它游戏化了，说实话，还挺好玩的。
cues.en: and you could argue they’ve almost gamified it which, honestly, is kinda fun.

cues.zh: 这就是这种费率方案下典型的夏日一天。
cues.en: This is what a typical summer day looks like on this rate schedule.

cues.zh: 每天都不一样，在较温和的日子里，费率往往甚至不超过每千瓦时6美分。
cues.en: This varies from day to day, and on milder days it often doesn’t even go above 6 cents per kilowatt-hour.

cues.zh: 你其实还能看到，在特别刮风的日子里
cues.en: You can actually see, too, that on particularly windy days

cues.zh: 全天费率都相当便宜。
cues.en: the rate’s pretty cheap all day.

cues.zh: 我们这一带风力发电很多。
cues.en: We’ve got a lot of wind power around here.

cues.zh: 不过，这并不是我最终实际支付的费率——
cues.en: Now, this isn’t the actual rate I end up paying -

cues.zh: 还有一个大约每千瓦时4美分的固定成本，所以实际上
cues.en: there is a fixed cost of about 4 cents per kilowatt hour so realistically

cues.zh: 最低大概在5到7美分之间，差不多这样。
cues.en: this bottoms out at about between 5 and 7 cents, something like that.

cues.zh: 但这还是比下午便宜多了，下午的费用很容易翻倍还不止。
cues.en: But that’s still a lot cheaper than in the afternoon where the cost can easily be more than double that.

cues.zh: 总之，半夜时需求最低
cues.en: Anyway, demand is lowest in the middle of the night

cues.zh: 至少按今天的能源结构，这时候电力公司从供应商那里购电的成本也是最低的。
cues.en: and at least with today’s energy mix that’s when it costs the utility the least to purchase electricity from its suppliers.

cues.zh: 这是因为需求这么低的时候
cues.en: That’s because with this low demand

cues.zh: 只需要便宜又高效的基载发电就够了。
cues.en: cheap and efficient baseload generation is the only supply that’s needed.

cues.zh: 所以，为了利用夜间的低电价，
cues.en: And, so that I can take advantage of these low rates at night,

cues.zh: 我用了一块大约16千瓦时的电池，正好手头就有一块。
cues.en: I use a roughly 16 kilowatt-hour battery that I just happen to have lying around.

cues.zh: 我晚上10点整开始充电
cues.en: I charge it up overnight starting at 10 PM on the dot

cues.zh: 通常到凌晨3、4点就充满了。
cues.en: and it’s done charging usually by 3 or 4 in the morning.

cues.zh: 我一直让它保持满电到7点左右
cues.en: I keep it topped off until around 7:00

cues.zh: 然后白天开始用它
cues.en: and then I start using it during the day

cues.zh: 一直到晚上才需要再充电。
cues.en: and it doesn’t need to be recharged again until the evening.

cues.zh: 我之所以正好有这么一块电池
cues.en: Now, the reason I just happen to have that battery lying around

cues.zh: 是因为那块电池就是我的房子。
cues.en: is because that battery is my house.

cues.zh: 感到困惑吗？
cues.en: Confused?

cues.zh: 谁说电池就一定要储存电能呢？
cues.en: Well, who’s to say a battery needs to store electricity?

cues.zh: 在我解释这个之前，
cues.en: Now, before I explain this,

cues.zh: 我先承认这有点看具体情况，我明白。
cues.en: let me acknowledge that this is somewhat situational and I get that.

cues.zh: 不是每栋建筑都能做到这一点，
cues.en: Not every building will be able to do this,

cues.zh: 但努力让更多人实现这一点
cues.en: but efforts to make this possible for more people

cues.zh: 可能大大有助于现在就提供一种大规模的储能来源。
cues.en: could go a long way to providing a massive source of energy storage right now.

cues.zh: 这栋房子大约有10年了，
cues.en: This house is about 10 years old,

cues.zh: 隔热良好，配有低辐射窗户，
cues.en: is well-insulated, features low-E windows,

cues.zh: 早晚还有树木遮阴。
cues.en: and is shaded by trees in the morning and evening.

cues.zh: 这一切意味着，即使在酷热难耐的日子里，
cues.en: All that means that even on sweltering hot days,

cues.zh: 室内空气温度也要好几个小时才会上升。
cues.en: it takes many hours for the indoor air temperature to rise.

cues.zh: 在典型的夏日，从早上6点到晚上10点
cues.en: On a typical summer day, between 6 AM and 10 PM

cues.zh: 气温只上升7到8华氏度，
cues.en: the air temperature only goes up by 7 or 8 degrees Fahrenheit,

cues.zh: 约合4.5摄氏度。
cues.en: or about 4.5 Celsius.

cues.zh: 所以，我白天根本不开空调降温。
cues.en: So, I just don’t cool my home during the day.

cues.zh: 完全不。
cues.en: At all.

cues.zh: 我不需要，因为我晚上把房子过度降温，就像给房子这块电池充了电。
cues.en: I don’t need to, because I charged the battery that is my house by overcooling it at night.

cues.zh: 听起来可能有点奇怪，但我并没有因此住得不舒服。
cues.en: Sure that might sound odd, but it’s not like I’m living uncomfortably.

cues.zh: 事实上恰恰相反。
cues.en: Quite the opposite, in fact.

cues.zh: 因为我喜欢睡觉时凉快一点，
cues.en: For how I like to sleep, which is nice and cool,

cues.zh: 这样安排简直完美。
cues.en: this works out perfectly.

cues.zh: 即使从早上6点半到晚上10点完全不降温，
cues.en: And even with no cooling from 6:30 AM to 10:00 PM,

cues.zh: 屋里也很少会超过74华氏度。
cues.en: it’s rare that it ever gets above 74 degrees in here.

cues.zh: 也就是23.3摄氏度。
cues.en: That’s 23.3 Celsius.

cues.zh: 这还是在晴天，并且用炉灶和烤箱做饭产生热量的情况下。
cues.en: This is even on sunny days and with heat from using the stove and oven for cooking.

cues.zh: 如果我晚上把房子降温，
cues.en: If I cool the house off at night,

cues.zh: 那直到第二天傍晚，我都不需要再降温了。
cues.en: I simply don’t need any cooling again until the following evening.

cues.zh: 我这么做快两年了，最热的时候屋里也只到过76华氏度。
cues.en: The worst it has ever gotten in the nearly two years I’ve been doing this is 76 degrees.

cues.zh: 我的恒温器日程是这样的。
cues.en: Here’s what my thermostat schedule looks like.

cues.zh: 在继续之前，
cues.en: And before I go on,

cues.zh: 我想说明，我并不是建议每个人都该采用这种特定策略。
cues.en: I want to be clear that I’m not suggesting everybody should have this particular strategy.

cues.zh: 我只是在解释我基于电价的策略。
cues.en: I’m just explaining my tactic which is based on pricing.

cues.zh: 不过，如果你所在的地区容易出现轮流停电，
cues.en: However, if you’re in an area that is prone to rolling blackouts,

cues.zh: 你或许可以考虑在热浪期间对空调运行时间也采取类似的策略。
cues.en: you might consider being similarly strategic with when your air conditioner runs during heatwaves.

cues.zh: 总之，晚上10点设定温度降到70华氏度，空调启动。
cues.en: Anyway, at 10 PM the set point drops to 70 degrees and the air conditioner comes on.

cues.zh: 在较温和的日子，空调可能三小时内就能满足需求，
cues.en: On a milder day the air conditioner may be able to satisfy that within three hours,

cues.zh: 让它短暂休息一下。
cues.en: giving it a short break.

cues.zh: 但到了凌晨1点（严格来说是第二天了）
cues.en: But at 1:00AM (which is technically the next day)

cues.zh: 设定温度又降到66华氏度，也就是19摄氏度。
cues.en: the set point drops again to 66 degrees or 19 Celsius.

cues.zh: 这看起来可能冷得过分，
cues.en: That may seem excessively cold

cues.zh: 但记住，我的目标是抵消我一天的全部制冷需求。
cues.en: but remember my goal here is to offset my entire cooling need of the day.

cues.zh: 这招真管用！
cues.en: And this works!

cues.zh: 我把这栋房子变成了一块电池，一块热电池。
cues.en: I’ve turned this house into a battery, a thermal battery.

cues.zh: 不过由于它比室外更凉快，所以算是一块负电池
cues.en: Although since it’s cooler than the outside it’s a negative battery

cues.zh: 但原理是一样的。
cues.en: but the concept is the same.

cues.zh: 因为我的电力公司给了我这样做的激励，
cues.en: Because my utility has provided me with an incentive to do so,

cues.zh: 而且我家的设计和选址足够好，让这件事成为可能，
cues.en: and since my home is designed and sited well enough to make it possible,
